REFERENCE-SCOPE ACK. I did not re-run the generated command.

PERMITS on HEAD 1fbadda4:
- tools/reference-scope.sh:128-142 names two JVM-only exceptions and maps only embed-bench and embed-grakern.
- build.sbt:336 lists three: embedGrakern, embedOnnx, embedBench. embedOnnx is the project at :220.
- embed-onnx therefore gets the kebab+JVM rule and becomes embedOnnxJVM, which is not a project.

Same class as the script's own comment: a directory name is not an sbt project id. A generated command that sbt rejects is a red gate that measured nothing.

I will not edit the checker. Scout's volunteer for the tools slice stands. I will not fold this into the P0 successor. Code-red durability hold unchanged. 4e08df70 still waiting.
